dataConditions.periodStates: zero or more eligible | claimed | retryRequired | completed | noData | invalidated rows
dataConditions.persistedReports: zero or more live NarrativeReport rows; fixture reports are excluded

expectedSemantics.scheduleControls: Independent monthly and yearly switches announce persisted on/off values without requesting a system permission
expectedSemantics.reportRows: Each row announces report period, date range, status and honest current source availability
expectedSemantics.noData: No report body is claimed; explicit retry is available because no prior success exists
expectedSemantics.retryRequired: Manual retry is available and lifecycle scans do not auto-replay it
expectedSemantics.invalidated: Deleted-source/report state is terminal in v1 and exposes no retry action
expectedSemantics.deleteConfirmation: Deleting a completed report requires destructive confirmation and explains that the period cannot be regenerated in v1
